=====================================================
 [3.2] BOSS: THE GATEKEEPER
=====================================================

  HP: 12,000      Weak: Ice      Resists: Fire
  Reward: 3,200 EXP   Item: Stone Key

PHASE 1
The Gatekeeper opens with a sweeping strike on the front row. Guard on
turn one and it wastes its opening. Use Ice attacks to knock it down, then
attack with everyone.

PHASE 2 (below 50% HP)
It raises its shield and charges for one turn. Do not attack during the
charge. Wait for the flash, then hit it with the strongest Ice skill.

TURN ORDER
  +--------+----------------------+
  | Turn   | Action               |
  +--------+----------------------+
  | 1      | Sweep (front row)    |
  | 2      | Shield up            |
  | 3      | Heavy strike (all)   |
  +--------+----------------------+

TIPS
 - Bring a healer.
 - Save before the door at the end of the hall.
   The boss follows you in.
 - Fire is useless here.

=====================================================
 [3.3] BOSS: THE SENTINEL
=====================================================

The Sentinel is slow but hits hard. Break its guard with Gun attacks, then
use an All-Out Attack. It heals when it is not attacked for two turns, so keep up the pressure and do not wait for it.
The second phase starts at half health and adds two helpers that you should defeat first or the fight takes much longer.
